svg.text: Does fibroblast Fzd loss alter an early competent pool?
Fzd2 versus Fzd1 loss is the comparison; a later output defect is a distinct endpoint
Qualified Fzd2 loss versus Fzd1 loss • adult AF1-like fibroblasts • independent units
Dashed: proposed comparison / readout • icons and counts are qualitative
Timing or pool adjustment does not prove mediation; survival, matrix and unequal engagement remain alternatives.
